column1: # manifests/ncz-timestamped.tsv -- reviewed NCZ packages whose VERSION embeds a
# build timestamp, so their .deb bytes cannot be statically sha-pinned in
# manifests/ncz-packages.tsv.  The NARROWEST safe rule applies (no wildcard
# package-name prefix, no blanket version glob):
#   * the package NAME must match exactly and the ARCH exactly;
#   * the VERSION must match the anchored regex below;
#   * the sha256 of the .deb actually installed MUST be recorded in the finished
#     by build/iso/write-usb-image.py).  The gate recomputes the .deb sha256 while
#     scanning the image and cross-checks it against that receipt entry; a
#     timestamped package with no matching receipt entry FAILS CLOSED.
# A row here is a reviewed act: the recipe and source_revision (upstream pins)
# must be non-empty, exactly like manifests/ncz-packages.tsv.

column6: Singularity Desktop payload; version = YYYYMMDDhhmmss+bk0+tgz<sha-prefix>; sha256 only via the image receipt
